messages:
Lina: Quick POC scoping for Polaris deal. Focus: multi-invoice reconciliation + QnA. Need golden set and gates.
Ravi: We'll need 250 golden invoices, include scanned OCR noise. Targets: reconciliation accuracy >= 0.88, QA F1 >= 0.85.
Keiko: Security asks: retention window must be <=30 days, KMS integration required. Also they asked about penetration testing schedule.
Lina: Procurement also asked about cost caps. FinanceOps, give a 3-scenario quote for 2 GPU commit.
OpsBot: Harness job enqueued. ETA 28h for baseline run with prefix cache toggles.
Ravi: Scoring formula I'll use: 0.65 reconciliation + 0.25 QA + 0.1 cost penalty. Regression gate: nightly check, block if any metric drops >6%.
Keiko: I'll prepare answers for the security questionnaire and add key rotation docs.
Lina: Action items and deadlines: Ravi (goldens, today), Keiko (security Qs, Wed), FinanceOps (pricing scenarios, EOD). Sync Friday 11am.
FinanceOps: Draft pricing uploaded to drive. Note: burst pricing doubles unit price beyond 3x baseline.
Lina: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll loop in AE.
